answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through hardware attestation. Agents authenticate via cryptographic proofs from secure enclaves sealed in basalt casings. An attacker incurs the verifiable manufacturing cost of dedicated silicon per persona, causing expenses to spiral with swarm scale. Revocation alerts ripple across gateways to isolate compromised identities. However, reliance on proprietary foundries creates centralized dependencies that restrict permissionless entry.
